items.title: Last day for objection (Widerspruch) against the revocation of unemployment benefit
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: The letter is dated Thu 27.08.2026 and gives no separate posting date, so the posting day is 27.08.2026. The letter says it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), which is Mon 31.08.2026. The Agentur für Arbeit is a social-law body, so the delivery day is not moved. The day of delivery is not counted. One month later is 30.09.2026, a Wednesday and not a public holiday, so the period ends that day. The objection must reach the agency by then.

warnings: Today (2026-09-30) is the last day of the objection period, so the objection must reach the agency today, for example by hand delivery or by recording it at the office. Sending it by post today is too late.
The amount of 1.318,20 € is the benefit the agency says it will still pay for August 2026. It is not a payment you have to make.
